title: Meetings online
prompt: Where will meetings be held now?
hint: Short sentence. Say that meetings are online.

ja.prompt: 会議はこれからどこで開かれますか？
ja.hint: 短い文で。会議がオンラインで行われると答えてください。
ja.sample: 会議はオンラインで行われます。

local.prompt: Where will meetings be held now?
local.hint: Short sentence. Say that meetings are online.

local_pron.prompt: wair wil mee-tingz bee held now?
local_pron.hint: short sen-tens. say mee-tingz are on-line.

zh.prompt: 會議現在將在哪裡舉行？
zh.hint: 用短句。說明會議在線上舉行。

en.prompt: Where will meetings be held now?
en.hint: Short sentence. Say that meetings are online.

en_pron.prompt: wɛr wɪl ˈmiːtɪŋz bi hɛld naʊ?
en_pron.hint: ʃɔrt ˈsɛntəns. seɪ ðæt ˈmiːtɪŋz ɑr ɑnˈlaɪn.

title: Protect everyone
prompt: What should people do to protect everyone?
hint: Give the full instruction from the text about safety.
sample: Please maintain social distancing and wear masks to protect everyone.

ja.prompt: 皆の安全を守るために人々は何をすべきですか？
ja.hint: 本文の安全に関する指示をそのまま答えてください。
ja.sample: 社会的距離を保ち、マスクを着用してください。

local.prompt: What should people do to protect everyone?
local.hint: Give the full instruction from the text about safety.
local.sample: Please maintain social distancing and wear masks to protect everyone.

local_pron.prompt: wut should pee-pul doo to pro-tekt ev-ree-wuhn?
local_pron.hint: give the full in-struc-shun from the tekst about sayf-tee.
local_pron.sample: pleez mayn-teyn soh-shuhl dis-tuhn-sing and wair masks to pro-tekt ev-ree-wuhn.

zh.prompt: 人們應該做什麼以保護每個人？
zh.hint: 直接用文本中關於安全的完整指示來回答。
zh.sample: 請保持社交距離並佩戴口罩以保護每個人。

en.prompt: What should people do to protect everyone?
en.hint: Give the full instruction from the text about safety.
en.sample: Please maintain social distancing and wear masks to protect everyone.

en_pron.prompt: wʌt ʃʊd ˈpiːpəl duː tuː prəˈtɛkt ˈɛvrɪwʌn?
en_pron.hint: gɪv ðə fʊl ɪnˈstrʌkʃən frəm ðə tɛkst əˈbaʊt ˈseɪfti.
en_pron.sample: pliːz meɪnˈteɪn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈdɪstənsɪŋ ənd wɛr mæsks tuː prəˈtɛkt ˈɛvrɪwʌn.
